technique_name: Identify a popular website and describe two features in detail.
description:
A popular website is YouTube. YouTube is an online video-sharing platform where users can watch, upload, and share videos. 

One of the main features of YouTube is the ability for users to easily find and share content with others. The website has a search function and a homepage with suggested videos based on users' interests, making it very convenient to browse for different types of content. It also provides users with the ability to create and curate their own channels to share their own vid
